title: The Psychopath Whisperer
subtitle: The Science of Those Without Conscience
pub: Crown Publishing, a division of Random House · 2014
paragraphs: Written for general readers, the book draws on more than two decades of interviewing people with psychopathic traits and scanning their brains, from Dr. Kiehl's first days in a maximum-security prison as a graduate student to the mobile MRI.

It was published in North America (Crown/Random House, 2014; paperback 2015) and the United Kingdom (Oneworld Publications, 2014; paperback 2015), and has been translated into seven languages: Chinese, Dutch, Finnish, German, Polish, Russian and Turkish. Rights were also sold in India in 2026. An unabridged audiobook, narrated by Kevin Pariseau, was released by Audible Studios and Brilliance Audio in 2014.

title: Handbook on Psychopathy and Law
subtitle: Oxford Series in Neuroscience, Law, and Philosophy
by: Edited by Kent A. Kiehl and Walter P. Sinnott-Armstrong
paragraphs: An edited volume bringing together scientists, clinicians, philosophers and legal scholars on what psychopathy is, how it is assessed, what is known about its causes and treatment, and what it means for criminal responsibility and sentencing.
